svg.text: New places: the rule must change its shape (transfer)
Each is a voyage where the sunflower's habit fails and the understood idea wins
inside: jars of kept air
The desert night (5.T1, 8.T1)
No clouds in the desert: open the doors
at night, keep the air in jars, build by
day behind shut doors. A white flower
opens under the stars.
The water lily (4.T2, 8.T3)
The leaf floats: its doors are on top.
Send air down the long stalk to the roots
in the mud.
spring
The winter tree (8.T2)
Frozen ground, no water: drop the leaves
and live on the store. In spring the
store sends sugar up to the buds.
The Mars dome (7.T1)
The crew breathes out CO2; the dome's
plants build sugar under red and blue
lamps and give back oxygen. Balance it.
